description: Calibrated audience-buzz assessment per artist, complementing VADER. State is a batch of recent mentions/listening observations for one artist.
name: festival-sentiment

criteria.unclear: Observations do not support a direction call

buzz_direction.instructions: Direction of audience buzz for this artist in the given observations.

buzz_momentum.instructions: Strength of the audience momentum signal.

data_quality_concern.instructions: The observations look like spam, bot activity, or otherwise unreliable for judging real audience buzz.

is_significant_shift.instructions: This represents a meaningful shift in audience attention, not routine chatter.

routing.note: Caller-side confidence escalation. Thresholds to be calibrated on labeled data.
